Card Q&A.a: The DP value printed on a card is its original DP. This card's effect temporarily allows you to treat the DP value printed on an opponent's Digimon as if it were 3000.

Yes, when a Digimon's DP becomes 0, it's deleted.
                                            
                        Related Cards
Card Q&A.q: I use this card's effect to change the original DP of an opponent's Digimon to 3000. I then use [ST3-11 Seraphimon]'s effect to give an opponent's Digimon -4000 DP. If the opponent's Digimon drops to 0 DP, is it deleted?

Card Q&A.a:
Yes, effects that increase or decrease DP work as normal, raising the Digimon's DP to 6000.
                                            
                        Related Cards
Card Q&A.q: This card's effect has set a Digimon's original DP to 3000. If [ST1-13 Shadow Wing] is used to give that Digimon +3000 DP, is its DP now 6000?

Card Q&A.a: No, its original DP becomes 3000. 3000 DP and 1000 DP (from the effect) add up to 4000 DP.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's effect on a Digimon that's already getting +1000 DP from an effect, does its DP become 3000?

Card Q&A.a: Even after digivolving, the Digimon's DP is treated as 3000 until the end of the turn.
Card Q&A.q: I digivolve a Digimon while this card's effect is active. What happens to the Digimon's DP?

Effect: [Main] Change the original DP of 1 of your opponent's Digimon to 3000 until the end of your opponent's next turn.
